Debbie counts on their fingers, twice, like they don't trust the first number. Then, to the fire: "0 for guilty. 6 against."
A long exhale moves around the fire like weather. "Not guilty — this time."
They're named, every one: Marcus Garcia, Tariq Fischer, Cole Nakamura. Your move — ask them questions (up to three), call a MOOT on it, or turn them away at the edge of the firelight.
They waited three days at the edge of your fire. Nobody called the moot. Marcus nods — not angry, just done — and they walk.

Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
